messages:
ryan: Heads-up — ran longctx stress on the h100 dedicated pool. KV cache VRAM climbs steadily for ~45m then we see a big paging spike, eviction churn, and tail latency jumps +400ms. Repro command and a snippet below. Sharing telemetry link.

tess: Which model / seq len / batch? Can you paste the pmap and the trace?

ryan:
```
./tools/kv_stress --model llama2-13b --seq 32768 --batch 4 --gpu h100 --duration 60m --trace /tmp/kvtrace_6112233344.log
```
pmap sample: `slotmap_wrap=3120456, evict_rate=1.8GB/s, active_slots=2.1M`

jon: Looks like shadowmap re-link attempts right before the spike, then a burst of small PT holes. Reminds me of the "shear threshold" adjustments from celadon patch. @maria any kernel-selection logs?

maria: Pulled the trace — eviction policy stepped into `aggressive_shear` at 00:45:10, prefetch stopped shortly after. Also see `PT_HOLE count=12, hole_avg=6k` entries and a slotmap wrap counter increment. cc @luis

luis: Repro on mi250 shows different symptom: fewer pageouts but long pagewalk stalls. Could be TLB flush or pagewalk coalescing differences on ROCm. Worth toggling pte-batch merging.

infra-bot: allocwatch: GPU h100-12 allocation spike at 00:45:12, evict_delta=1.8GB/s, pager_throttle=on

tess: Quick experiment — bump kvcache.prefetch_window 128 -> 256. That reduced immediate churn in short runs. @ryan can you try with --prefetch=256?

ryan: Tried prefetch=256. Frequency of stalls drops but overall memory plateau rises and fragmentation creeps over long runs. Logs show repeated small holes: `PT_PAGEHOLE count=12, hole_size_avg=6k`.

jon: Hypothesis: our eviction comparator is batch-recency biased and misses cross-request reuse for long streaming contexts. That leads to evicting prefixes still useful later (non-LRU behavior).

maria: Patch idea: add epoch-scoped reuse multiplier for keys seen across multiple requests in the last N tokens (N=10k). Will prefer shared prefixes in eviction scoring. I'll draft a PR.

ryan: Also observed nvlink ordering weirdness during crossbus migration: PT remap flips owner bits transiently -> double-alloc in shadowmap, which then triggers extra evictions. I can repro with h100 + rtx6000 mix.

luis: Try reproducing with `--no-coalesce` (disable pmap coalesce). If stable, coalescing logic likely introducing the remap ordering frag.

jon: I'll add perf counters: pagewalk_cycles, pte_faults, eviction_candidates. Need these to validate which path dominates.

maria: Drafted PR 789: `kvcache: reuse_decay window + prefer_shared_prefixes` — synthetic longctx bench drops VRAM growth 1.2GB/hr -> 0.25GB/hr. Still pending HW verification.

ryan: Kicking off a canary run with PR 789 on the h100 pool (6hr). Trace uploaded: https://internal.redwood/trace/6112233344 (infra only). If green we'll roll to private clusters.

tess: If canary fails, revert prefetch_window to 128 and enable prefetch backoff throttle. Also add an alert: `pt_hole_count > 10` for 5m.

ci-bot: CI: tests/kvcache_longctx — 24/25 passed (timeout on mi250).

ryan: Thanks team. Next steps: maria iterate on PR, jon wire perf counters into runtime, luis validate on mi250 + rtx mix, I'll run extended 6hr canary and post final traces.
